title: Pray for God’s Presence
verse: The Lord is near to all who call on Him, to all who call on Him in truth.
prayer: Lord, draw near to my child. Let them feel Your presence and know that You are with them in every moment, even in their struggles. Surround them with Your love and peace.

title: Pray for Conviction and Repentance
verse: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to purify us from all unrighteousness.
prayer: Father, I pray for gentle conviction to lead my child to repentance. Let them understand the depth of Your forgiveness and feel encouraged to turn back to You wholeheartedly.

title: Pray for a Renewed Mind
verse: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind.
prayer: Lord, renew my child’s mind with Your Word. Replace thoughts of temptation with thoughts of truth, purity, and peace. Help them to focus on things that glorify You.

title: Pray for Freedom from Strongholds
verse: The weapons we fight with are not the weapons of the world. They have divine power to demolish strongholds.
prayer: Father, demolish any stronghold of pornography or masturbation in my child’s life. Break the chains that hold them captive and replace them with Your strength and freedom.

title: Pray for Purity
verse: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
prayer: Lord, create in my child a pure heart. Let their thoughts, desires, and actions be aligned with Your will. Guide them to pursue purity in all areas of their life.

title: Pray for Accountability
verse: Two are better than one, because they have a good return for their labor.
prayer: Lord, place godly mentors and friends in my child’s life who will encourage them, hold them accountable, and walk with them through their struggles with love and support.

title: Pray for Self-Control
verse: For the Spirit God gave us does not make us timid, but gives us power, love, and self-discipline.
prayer: Father, grow the fruit of self-control in my child. Give them the strength to resist temptation and the discipline to choose what honors You.

title: Pray for Healing from Shame
verse: Those who look to Him are radiant; their faces are never covered with shame.
prayer: Lord, heal my child from any shame or guilt they feel about their struggles. Remind them that Your grace is sufficient and that they are deeply loved and valued.

title: Pray for Gratitude
verse: Give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
prayer: Father, cultivate a heart of gratitude in my child. Let them find joy in the blessings You have given them and focus on the goodness of Your provision.

title: Pray for Protection from Temptation
verse: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.
prayer: Lord, protect my child from the things that lead them into temptation. Guard their eyes, mind, and heart. Help them to flee from situations that put them at risk.

title: Pray for Strength to Resist
verse: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
prayer: Father, give my child the strength to resist the enemy. Help them to rely on Your power and find victory in moments of temptation.

title: Pray for Confidence in Their Identity in Christ
verse: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!
prayer: Lord, remind my child of their identity in You. Help them see themselves as a new creation, free from the weight of their past struggles.

title: Pray for Joy in the Lord
verse: The joy of the Lord is your strength.
prayer: Father, restore joy to my child’s heart. Let their happiness be rooted in You, giving them strength and peace in every situation.

title: Pray for a Desire for God’s Word
verse: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
prayer: Lord, give my child a hunger for Your Word. Let them turn to Scripture for guidance, strength, and comfort.

title: Pray for a Spirit of Perseverance
verse: Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
prayer: Father, help my child to persevere, even when the journey feels hard. Give them courage to continue pursuing freedom and purity.

title: Pray for Wisdom in Choices
verse: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to you.
prayer: Father, give my child wisdom to make choices that honor You. Help them discern what is right and avoid situations that lead to temptation.

title: Pray for Emotional Healing
verse: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
prayer: Lord, heal my child’s heart from any emotional pain caused by their struggles. Replace their brokenness with wholeness and peace.

title: Pray for Boldness to Ask for Help
verse: Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.
prayer: Lord, give my child the courage to seek help when they need it. Surround them with people who will support and encourage them in their journey.

title: Pray for Contentment
verse: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
prayer: Father, teach my child to find contentment in You rather than seeking fulfillment in temporary pleasures. Let them see the beauty of what You have provided.

title: Pray for a Spirit of Forgiveness
verse: Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other, just as in Christ God forgave you.
prayer: Lord, help my child to forgive themselves for their struggles. Remind them that Your forgiveness is complete and unconditional.

title: Pray for a Heart of Service
verse: Each of you should use whatever gift you have received to serve others, as faithful stewards of God’s grace in its various forms.
prayer: Father, give my child a desire to serve others. Let them focus on helping and uplifting others, finding purpose in living for Your glory.

title: Pray for Healthy Relationships
verse: Do not be misled: ‘Bad company corrupts good character.’
prayer: Lord, guide my child to build relationships with people who encourage them to grow closer to You. Protect them from unhealthy influences.

title: Pray for Renewed Hope
verse: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in Him.
prayer: Father, fill my child with hope in You. Remind them that their future is bright because of Your promises and faithfulness.

title: Pray for Confidence to Overcome
verse: I can do all this through Him who gives me strength.
prayer: Lord, give my child confidence in Your strength. Let them know that with You, they can overcome any challenge.

title: Pray for Patience in the Process
verse: But if we hope for what we do not yet have, we wait for it patiently.
prayer: Father, teach my child patience as they work toward freedom. Help them trust that You are guiding them, even when the progress feels slow.

title: Pray for Protection from the Enemy
verse: Put on the full armor of God, so that you can take your stand against the devil’s schemes.
prayer: Lord, protect my child from the enemy’s attacks. Equip them with Your armor to stand firm against temptation.

title: Pray for Joy in Obedience
verse: If you love me, keep my commands.
prayer: Father, let my child find joy in obeying You. Show them the blessings that come from walking in alignment with Your will.

title: Pray for Peace in Their Mind
verse: You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast, because they trust in You.
prayer: Lord, calm my child’s mind and fill it with Your peace. Help them focus on Your truth rather than on anxiety or fear.

title: Pray for a Spirit of Gratitude
verse: Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good; His love endures forever.
prayer: Father, fill my child’s heart with gratitude for Your love and faithfulness. Let them approach each day with thankfulness for Your blessings.

title: Pray for Spiritual Growth
verse: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
prayer: Lord, help my child grow deeper in their relationship with You. Strengthen their faith and lead them to experience Your grace more fully.

title: Pray for Victory and Freedom
verse: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free.
prayer: Father, I declare victory over my child’s struggles. Thank You for setting them free and giving them the strength to live in purity and joy. May they walk boldly in the freedom You have given them.
